title: June 2020 box was just OK...
text: I got my wife a subscription for her birthday... This box contained ZSkin Cosmetics Mid-Day Shine Control (wife doesn't have oily skin, so she will more than likely not use.), Vitamasques Aloe Vera Hydro Sheet Jelly Mask (excited to try), Gemma Simone Trio Summer Earrings (cute but will pass them along to my daughter), Earth Stripped Vitamin Sea Beach Blanket (cute will most likely use as a small area rug), Inkling Scents Forest Whispers Perfume Oil (smells delightful), The Happy Shoppe Ocean Breeze 100% Soy Candle (just okay), Buoy Easy Squeeze Electrolytes (excited to try), and this months happiness boosting activity is an Adventure Journal! Here is hoping next month's box is better.
label: neutral
